The '''Lahag Erli''' were the natives of [[Lahag Erli]] in the [[Lahag Erli system/Legends|Lahag Erli system]].

They invaded the worlds of the [[Har system]] and left exquisite architecture behind on many of the [[Har Worlds]], including [[Har Binande]], which would attract tourists to the planet who did not know what the troubles the occupied people had gone through.
